info.title: IEP — Employee Idea Evaluation & Innovation Platform
info.description:
GENERATED FILE — do not edit.

Source of truth: packages/contracts/src/api.ts. Regenerate with `pnpm openapi:generate`.
CI fails if this file is stale (SPEC §11.3). Breaking changes require a superseding ADR (SPEC §14.1).

get.summary: Append-only audit trail (FR-29). Every row links to its subject.
Departments, for assigning one to an account.
Users and their roles.

post.summary: Create an account and assign its roles.

patch.summary: Change roles, department, active state, or set a new password.

get.summary: P14 organisational analytics (FR-27). Read-only aggregates; every idea count carries its list href.
Download an attachment. Authorises against the idea, then streams the bytes.

delete.summary: Remove an attachment from an editable version.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password (ADR-023).

get.summary: The signed-in user, their roles and department.

post.summary: Create your own EMPLOYEE account and sign in (FR-01a).

get.summary: Whether self-registration is open, and on what terms (FR-01a).
Idea categories, including how many ideas currently use each.

post.summary: P10. Adds a new idea category.

patch.summary: P10. Renames or (de)activates a category — never deleted, only deactivated.

get.summary: Evaluation criteria. Read-only — underwrites explainability (NFR-03).
P12 similarity/match-cutoff thresholds (AI-10/AI-11).
The curated capability catalogue FR-21's detection searches against.

post.summary: P10. Adds a catalogue entry. Its embedding is computed server-side, worker-side (SPEC §4.4).

patch.summary: P10. Edits or deactivates a catalogue entry; re-embeds when the description changes.

get.summary: Evaluation profiles and their weights, each summing to 100%.

patch.summary: P10 (FR-13). Replaces a profile's whole weight set — a rebalance, not a patch — and always records the reason (SPEC §9.8).

get.summary: The nine counts of REQUIREMENTS §29. Every tile carries its destination href.

post.summary: Submit a free-text research query to the Discovery Agent (SPC-1..SPC-10).

get.summary: The signed-in user's own discovery history (SPC-15 — never another user's).
Poll one discovery query's status and, once SUCCEEDED, its report.
Liveness probe. Deliberately discloses nothing beyond process state.

post.summary: Start a conversation with the idea-creation agent. An opening message is optional.

get.summary: The signed-in user's own conversations, newest first — never another user's.
Poll one conversation's messages and its current structured draft.

patch.summary: The employee's own correction to the draft, independent of any AI turn — always wins over the AI's inference (brief §4).

post.summary: Send the employee's next turn. The AI's reply is produced asynchronously.

get.summary: List ideas, scoped to what the actor may see (SPEC §4.2).

post.summary: Create a draft, or submit and start analysis.

get.summary: Idea detail, including what this actor is permitted to do with it.

patch.summary: Edit a DRAFT or NEEDS_CLARIFICATION idea in place. Submitted ideas are immutable.

get.summary: All AI-derived analysis for the current version, with provenance on every block.
Seven-step run state for the determinate stepper (SPEC §8.4).

Live SSE progress for the determinate stepper — the same state getAnalysisStatus returns, pushed on change instead of polled (SPEC §3.3, NFR-06). Reserved at P0 (AcceptedResponse.streamUrl already points here); wired up §14.1.
Files attached to the idea's current version (FR-02).

post.summary: Attach a PDF, DOCX or TXT. Type is sniffed from magic bytes (SPEC §4.3).

get.summary: Criterion scores, composite, maturity and the ranking with its explanation.

post.summary: Adjust a criterion score. Reason mandatory; writes score_overrides + audit_log atomically.

get.summary: Thumbs up and down totals, plus this person's own vote (FR-18).

post.summary: Record, change or clear your vote. Never affects the ranking (FR-18, P-1).

get.summary: Versions with evaluation deltas, plus the status lane (FR-24).
Leadership decision history for an idea's AI recommendation(s).

post.summary: Record the final organisational decision on an AI implementation recommendation. Never itself transitions idea status (P-3).

get.summary: Review history for an idea.

post.summary: Validate, request clarification, or reject with a reason (FR-22).

get.summary: Structured feedback (the five non-vote reasons) — what people said, and this person's own active types (FR-18).

post.summary: Add, update, or remove one structured-feedback entry. Never affects the ranking (FR-18, P-1).
Move an idea through the lifecycle. Validated against the transition table.
Revise an idea. Creates v(n+1) and re-runs only the steps whose inputs changed.

get.summary: Version list for the History tab.
Frozen snapshot of one version.

A person's own activity: plain counts (ideas submitted, feedback/reviews/decisions given) and a recent, newest-first timeline of the same. Scoped to what the signed-in viewer may read — an idea they cannot see contributes to no count and appears in no entry (P-1, permission matrix).
Ranked board for a profile. Each row carries its top strength and constraint.
A specific immutable ranking run (ADR-008).
Side-by-side comparison of 2–4 ideas, naming where they diverge.

post.summary: Recompute a cohort. Creates a NEW immutable run; makes no provider call.

get.summary: Ideas awaiting reviewer action, oldest first.
